newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MICROLINK TURNOVER UP 106 PERCENT IN H1 '97.
newsitem.headline: MICROLINK TURNOVER UP 106 PERCENT IN H1 '97.

text.p: The largest computer producer in the Baltics, Microlink, said on Thursday its net turnover was 82.6 million kroons in the first six months of 1997, up 106 percent compared with the same period last year.
The sharp rise stemmed from high demand for its computers in Latvia and Lithuania, it added in a statement. It sold 30 percent of its products in the other Baltic countries.
Falling computer prices, which have dropped 13 percent since 1996, also contributed to the sales increase.
Microlink has a 15.1 percent market share in the Baltics and the majority of Estonia's computer market.
